# Jelgava Coworking Space

> Quiet, 24/7 coworking space in Jelgava, Latvia, at Kazarmes iela 16B. Serves freelancers, IT specialists, photographers, videographers, students and entrepreneurs in Jelgava, Ozolnieki, Dobele, Olaine and Mārupe.

- Website (Latvian, default): https://jelgavacoworking.lv/lv/
- Website (Russian): https://jelgavacoworking.lv/ru/
- Website (English): https://jelgavacoworking.lv/en/
- Address: Kazarmes iela 16B, Jelgava, LV-3001, Latvia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +371 2057 9106
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/jelgava.coworking/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jelgava-coworking-space/
- Hours: 24/7 for Studio and Business plan holders; day pass and Focus/Flow plans Mon–Fri 9:00–18:00

## Packages
- Focus — €80/month, 10 workdays, Mon–Fri 9:00–18:00
- Flow — €110/month, unlimited Mon–Fri 9:00–18:00
- Studio — €140/month, 24/7 hot desk (most popular)
- Business — €170/month, 24/7 fixed desk + legal address service
- Day pass — €15 (Mon–Fri 9:00–18:00)
- Meeting room rental — €15/hour or €20/2 hours
